add_definitions(-D__ROS_LONG64__)
spec2def(inetmib1.dll inetmib1.spec)

 # CORE-5743: No ARRAY_SIZE macro

# inetmib1.dll is all Rust (inetmib1-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/inetmib1-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# main.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/inetmib1-rust/src/inetmib1/main.rs)
add_cargo_module(inetmib1 inetmib1-cargo inetmib1.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE inetmib1-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    DELAY_IMPORTS
    EXTRA_DEPENDS psdk)

include(c_oracle.cmake)  # the pre-flip C as <target>_c: python -m rustconv.c_oracle
